- Added Coleweight and Farming Weight profile fetching, with detailed weight breakdown screens accessible accessible via `/sct cw profile` and `/sct fw profile`.

- Reduced the frequency of stat parsing.
- Improved temporary buff usage detection and parsing.
---

- Fixed mining fortune label not updating properly.
- Fixed the Precision Mining box not rendering on some tungsten blocks while in a mineshaft.
- Fixed the pause, resume and stop commands not working when API server is down.
- Fixed status code 429 being treated as unreachable server.
- Fixed always requesting top 1k Coleweight and Farmingweight leaderboard entries.
- Fixed pickaxe cooldown reduction not being applied after rejoining.
- Fixed the server status timer preventing client shutdown. (#40)
- Fixed Coleweight top leaderboard parsing for the new API response.
- Fixed party chat messages displaying color codes. (#39)
- Fixed passed player showing the wrong previous player. (#38)
---

releases.notes:
## What's New
- Added a new config option for sending the timer/stopwatch times in party chat. (#36)
- Implemented a new milestone system for collections and skills, with separate overlays and chat, title and sound notifications when completed. (#32)
- Added support for the Fiesta Flask consumable.
- Added support for timber stat in the Foraging Stats Overlay.
- Added an option to include wiped profiles in leaderboards. (#30)
- Added support for displaying the previous leaderboard position for collections and skills. (#29)
---
## Improvements
- Removed AFK detection from skill tracking.
- Added a toggle to cycle stats for multi-tracking when opening the chat.
- Added colored outlines to the skill tracker overlay and when tracking gemstones.
- Added `last update` line to collection multi-tracking.
- Added a new custom screen for setting custom leaderboard positions via `/sct leaderboard`.
- Removed customGoalAmount/customGoalPosition logic and commands.
- Made most commands unavailable outside Skyblock.
- Merged collection and skill tracking commands and added tracker type to the stop/pause/resume/restart commands.
- Shortened rotating perks' buff names.
- Implemented rate decay for collection tracking and summaries. (#35)
- Optimized heatmap rendering and added support for mineshafts.
- Fixed the mining fortune label not updating correctly in the overlay.
- Removed the original ability formatting, keeping Coleweight's formatting as the default.
- Improved overlay rendering.
- Removed the automatic disabling of overlays that require tab data when tab data is unavailable.
- Added a "Too low" rank indicator for players outside the leaderboard.
- Improved CotM/CotF, professional and strong arm level detection from the HotM/HotF menus.
- Renamed Powder Pumpkin to Powder Pie.
- Made all API requests asynchronous to avoid blocking the main thread.
---
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed `Extra Stats` only appearing when opening the chat.
- Fixed clearing the collection leaderboard when stopping skill tracking.
- Fixed perk unlocked message being sent when resetting HotM/HotF.
- Fixed skill tracking not displaying the previous leaderboard player and custom player position.
- Fixed Sky Mall/Lottery/Beekeeper times always showing "Soon" until the next update in some cases.
- Fixed collections not being colored in summaries.
- Fixed gemstones not being trackable via `/sct track gemstone` and allowed multi-tracking individual gemstones.
- Fixed cooldown reduction from Sky Mall persisting after changing loadouts.
---
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ChindeaOne/SkyblockCollectionTracker-fabric/compare/2.7.1...2.7.2

Please report any issues with the mod [here](https://github.com/ChindeaOne/SkyblockCollectionTracker-fabric/issues)

releases.notes:
## What's New
- Added support for Minecraft 1.21.11.
- Discontinued support for Minecraft 1.21.8.
- Added a commissions overlay, inspired by NEU’s layout.
- Added a dynamic mining stats overlay.
- Added Mining Island–only feature for mining stats.
- Collection Tracking:
  - Added Sack Tracking (experimental).
  - Added new tracking stats: `Money made`, `Collection gained since last check`.
  - Additional stats when using Bazaar pricing.
  - Added additional Bazaar/Auction items for Rift collections.
  - Implemented a Tracking Summary shown at the end of a session, including best and worst rates.
  - Added a `/sct restart` command to restart tracking for the same collection (up to 10 times per hour).
- Skill Tracking:
  - Note: Hunting isn't trackable yet because Hypixel doesn't expose any data in the API.
  - New tracker for skills.
  - Maxed skills update live, while non-maxed skills update using API calls (similar to collection tracking).
  - Taming can be tracked separately alongside the main skill.
- Other additions:
  - Added option to display explicit values in tracking overlays.
  - Added `/sct edit` command to open the position editor.
---
## Improvements
- Improved `/sct track` suggestions to better support multi-word collection names.
- Collections list is now paginated by category.
- Rift collections now use Motes per hour and Motes made instead of coin values where applicable.
- Increased API fetch interval (180s → 200s) and reduced tracking cooldown (15s → 10s).
- Updated commissions keybind behavior to work similar to Firmament's wardrobe keybinds.
- Improved version naming differentiation across Minecraft versions.
- Improved collection tracking while using Sack Tracking.
- Renamed `/sct help` to `/sct commands`
---
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed crash when tracking Rift collections
- Fixed crash when editing overlays. (#6)
- Fixed data never being fetched if API server is down on join.
- Fixed sack tracking causing collection rates to increase too fast.
- Fixed collection/hour stat not updating when gains were very small.
- Fixed “Collection since last” not rendering.
- Fixed update message sometimes not appearing in chat.
- Fixed API error that allowed collection tracking to continue when data fetching failed.
- Fixed scoreboard detection so tracking now works on Ironman, Stranded, and Bingo profiles (#2).
- Fixed tracking randomly stopping due to Hypixel API synchronization delays.
- Fixed NPC price fetching.
- Fixed missing collection overlay colors.
- Fixed occasional crashes caused by configuration loading.
- Fixed overlay dummy elements sometimes not rendering before overlays initialized.
- Fixed `/sct collections` not sending clickable chat messages.
- Fixed modrinthautoupdater failing due to a packaging issue.
---
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ChindeaOne/SkyblockCollectionTracker-fabric/compare/v1.0.8...v1.0.9

Please report any issues with the mod [here](https://github.com/ChindeaOne/SkyblockCollectionTracker-fabric/issues)
